paragraphs: Turnout gear is three garments pretending to be one: an outer shell that resists flame, a moisture barrier under it, and a thermal liner inside that. The reflective banding is the only part the public ever notices, and it is the part that matters least to the wearer.
The suit holds 56,405 polygons and 58,245 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and is built to CheckMate specification.
At $99 it suits emergency services visualisation, safety and training material, protective equipment marketing, character work, film costume and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The humpback's flippers are nearly a third of its body length, longer than any other animal's limbs relative to size, and the knobs along their leading edge turned out to delay stall the way an aircraft wing device does. Engineers have been copying them ever since.

The model is light at 24,396 polygons and 24,374 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, suited to open water scenes where the animal is one element among many. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $99 it suits marine and wildlife visualisation, documentary and education work, conservation material, game environments, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The pendulum ride is a fairground machine built to make people feel they have been dropped without ever letting go of them. Switched off, it is just a steel arm and a gondola, and the whole structure is legible in a way it never is while running.
The model holds 335,042 polygons and 356,937 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the switched off configuration, and carries StemCell certification.
At $99 it suits amusement park and leisure visualisation, architectural and urban scenes, equipment presentation, film backgrounds, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

The multi screen laptop is a machine built for people who refuse to accept that portability means one display. Folded shut it looks impossibly thick, and that thickness is the entire product: several panels stacked where a normal machine has one.
The model holds 68,646 polygons and 71,213 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the closed configuration. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $99 it suits product and technology visualisation, e-commerce and catalogue imagery, advertising, office and interior scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The Cayuse is an egg with a rotor on top, and the shape was chosen for drag rather than for looks. It was small, fast and hard to hit, which made it the aircraft sent to find out what was in a treeline before anything larger went near it.
The model carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $99 it suits military aviation and documentary work, flight simulation, period film and television, museum material and game environments. On sale since 2016.

A modern tram is a low floor vehicle, and everything that makes it look modern follows from that single decision: the wheels moved out of the cabin, the doors dropped to pavement height, and the passenger no longer climbs anything to board.
The model holds 721,551 polygons and 744,717 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, with a simple interior. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $99 it suits urban and transport visualisation, infrastructure presentation, architectural scenes, advertising, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2025.

The multi purpose ATV is a category defined by attachments rather than by the vehicle. A flat rear deck, a tow point and a chassis that will take a plough, a sprayer or a stretcher, depending on whether the day involves a farm, a park or a rescue.
The model holds 821,668 polygons and 425,055 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification for use across engines and renderers.
At $99 it suits agricultural and utility visualisation, equipment marketing, outdoor and recreation scenes, emergency services material, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2023.

An attack submarine hunts other submarines, which means everything on it is subordinate to being quiet. The teardrop hull, the anechoic tiles and the raft the machinery sits on all exist for the same reason: to make the boat as close to a hole in the water as engineering allows.

The model is very light at 11,883 polygons and 12,444 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 4096x4096, suited to wide scenes and background use. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $99 it suits naval and defence visualisation, documentary and news graphics, simulation, film and game environments. On sale since 2017.

The wellhead is the small part of an oil well that anyone ever sees. Everything of consequence is thousands of metres below it, and the stack of valves at the surface exists to hold that back, which is why it is called a Christmas tree by everyone in the industry.
The model holds 294,086 polygons and 303,819 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 17 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $99 it suits oil and gas visualisation, energy infrastructure presentation, training and safety material, documentary work, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2018.

White is the base colour tour operators buy and then wrap, because the vehicle changes route, city and branding faster than it wears out. An unwrapped open top bus is therefore the most useful version for a mockup: it is what the livery goes on.
The model holds 284,722 polygons and 163,602 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, with a simple interior, and carries StemCell certification.
At $99 it suits livery mockups and fleet presentation, tourism and travel imagery, urban and architectural scenes, advertising, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2023.

The Orion V is a piece of North American transit history: a high floor bus from before low floor boarding became mandatory, with the steps at the door that a generation of riders remembers and that eventually made the design obsolete.

The model holds 377,252 polygons and 387,028 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 13 maps, 7 at 4096x4096 and 6 at 2048x2048, with a simple interior. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and the library holds a wide range of liveries and rigged builds around it.
At $99 it suits urban and transport visualisation, period and film scenes, fleet mockups, architectural renders, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

The pedestal is the part of the Manneken Pis nobody photographs, and it is most of the monument. The statue itself is famously tiny; the niche, the basin and the stonework around it are what give a small bronze figure the presence of a landmark.
This is supplied as the pedestal, and it carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $99 it suits architectural and historical visualisation, museum and exhibition work, urban scenes, film backgrounds, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

More pilots have learned in a Cherokee than in almost anything else. The low wing, the single door and the forgiving stall are all deliberate teaching decisions, and the aeroplane's reputation rests on being difficult to frighten yourself in.

The airframe is light at 47,445 polygons and 49,525 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, suited to scenes where the aircraft is one element among many. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $99 it suits general aviation visualisation, flight training and simulation, airfield scenes, advertising, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2024.

A grazing zebra spends most of the day with its head down, which is the pose almost nobody models. The stripes are what everyone notices, but the useful detail here is the posture: an animal eating is an animal that has decided nothing is hunting it.
The model is very light at 11,702 polygons and 12,181 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so a herd can be built without weight. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $99 it suits wildlife and nature visualisation, documentary and education work, safari and tourism imagery, game environments, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.
